verdict.rationale: Zulip has its own REST API, including send-message, backed by a machine-readable OpenAPI spec. It also has a bot framework that can run unattended in production through the Zulip Botserver, so it can be driven programmatically without the UI. However, nothing in the pack shows a headless CLI, CI-pipeline usage, or a guide for automating Zulip from CI jobs. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless run mode, CI integration docs or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Zulip's API has a powerful framework for interactive bots that react to messages in Zulip. You can write and run a custom bot
deploying it on a server using the Zulip Botserver
The zulip/zulip repository ships a complete OpenAPI 3.0.1 description of the API, info title "Zulip REST API"
